title: A worklist service and the UI in front of it
thesis: One collection, six states, and every refusal says which field it refused — the boring parts done properly are the product.
falsified_by: one response shape a client cannot predict from the contract, or one refusal that does not name its field
unit: one surface, with its contract, its refusals and a corpus that proves it against a running process
target_note: A service this size does not need a 350k wave. Declaring the smaller budget is the point: a wave is sized to the work, not to the window.

reference.why: Measured against the service that actually exists in this workspace, not against a guess. `bb tokens estimate demo/src` is the same walk.

surfaces.why: is it up at all, and does it know how much it holds
the thing the product is about
the only surface a person actually sees

waves.title: the contract

lanes.title: the store: durability behind one map
lanes.owes: a read never touches the disk and a write always does; no file yet is a first run, not an error

lanes.title: items: what an item is, and the only place that decides
